acceptance: DuckDB loads Vortex, DuckLake and Iceberg without to_pylist.
Test asserts the factory returns the native handler for each format.
description: DuckDB's handler factory (duckdb.py:893-923) only routes Delta, CSV and Parquet. Vortex files and DuckLake/Iceberg dirs fall to generic handlers (base/data_loading.py:1080-1390) that read the full table to Arrow, call to_pylist(), then executemany. DuckDBVortexHandler (duckdb.py:1395) and DuckDBDuckLakeHandler (:1206) exist but are unused. Wire them in; for generic handlers on engines that accept Arrow, use INSERT ... SELECT FROM the Arrow table.
